astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0 to read, verify or ask; 1 percent of the transaction only when AstraNL coordinated a completed paid task; nothing else, ever
astranl.do_not_use_when: you want cryptographic proof of what happened (get_evidence) or you hold a receipt or event id of another kind (verify_astranl)
astranl.example_intent: What happened with RCPT-6360 and who has to act now?
astranl.next_possible_action: get_evidence with the task_id when a signed trail is needed
astranl.proof_level: state read from the store; not signed
required_inputs: receipt_key from create_task for owner links; without it the answer is read-only
astranl.returns: state, next_actor and its basis, events after receipt; nothing is inferred beyond the recorded state
astranl.use_when: you hold a receipt_id or task_id from create_task and want the current state and who must act next

description: Current state of a task or ingress receipt from create_task, and who must act next. Returns only what is recorded; infers nothing.

receipt_key.description: owner key shown once by create_task; without it links are read-only

task_id.description: task id from check_task or a case

name: check_task
